name: wait-ping
description: Sends a local OS notification when a long turn ends or a permission confirm is waiting. Sound stays off until you turn it on.

enabled.title: Notify when a turn ends or needs permission
enabled.description: On by default. A local notification when a turn runs at least the threshold, or when a permission confirm is waiting. Off leaves every turn silent.

sound.title: Play a sound with the notification
sound.description: Off by default. The notification stays silent unless this is on.

thresholdSeconds.title: Turn length before a stop notification, in seconds
thresholdSeconds.description: A turn shorter than this does not notify when it ends. A permission confirm still notifies.
